_how: High/critical npm advisories that may stay for now. Gate: scripts/ci/npm-audit-gate.mjs (api-ci.yml). Each entry needs id (GHSA), package, reason and an expiry date (YYYY-MM-DD); an expired entry fails CI again.

advisories.reason: Only in the Prisma CLI (migrations/generate at build time), never in the API at runtime; the fix is the Prisma 7 major upgrade.

Published 2026-11-01; no patched release exists yet (1.16.2 is the latest). Needs a redirect that crosses realms while carrying custom credentials; to be re-checked and upgraded as soon as a fix ships.
Published 2026-11-01; no patched release exists yet (5.33.19 is the latest). The flaw is in the Windows-only services() call; our containers run Linux. To be upgraded as soon as a fix ships.
